recipes.title: Provençal Culinary Lavender, Honey & Wild Blueberry Rolled Oats
recipes.summary: Creamy oat-milk rolled oats infused gently with a light 1/4 tsp steep of food-grade culinary lavender buds, swirled with wild blueberries, honey, orange zest, toasted almonds, and flaxseed oil.

ingredient_details.item: food-grade dried culinary lavender buds (Lavandula angustifolia)
ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm oat milk inside a fine tea infuser and removed cleanly

steps: Warm oat milk gently over low heat with 1/4 tsp food-grade culinary lavender buds sealed inside a tea infuser for 4 minutes until softly fragrant, then lift out the infuser cleanly.
Stir in rolled oats and ground cinnamon and simmer gently 6 to 7 minutes until tender and creamy.
Fold in half the wild blueberries and honey so the oats turn softly marbled violet.
Spoon into two bowls and finish with remaining blueberries, orange zest, sliced almonds, and a cool drizzle of flaxseed oil.
tips: Always measure culinary lavender with a dedicated 1/4 tsp spoon—a light hand tastes like sweet Provençal honey rather than soapy perfume.
Steeping buds in a clamped tea ball keeps every spoonful smooth with zero stray dried buds.

recipes.title: Warm Lavender-Infused Apricot, Almond & Buckwheat Porridge
recipes.summary: Toasted buckwheat groats simmered in almond milk softly scented with culinary lavender, plump snipped apricots, Medjool dates, cinnamon, toasted almonds, and sweet culinary almond oil.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in hot water inside an infuser and strained

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender buds in 1 cup hot water covered for 4 minutes, then lift out the infuser and discard buds.
Combine strained lavender water, almond milk, rinsed buckwheat groats, snipped apricots, chopped dates, and cinnamon in a saucepan.
Cover and simmer over low heat 12 to 14 minutes until the buckwheat is tender and apricots are jammy.
Divide into warm bowls and drizzle with culinary almond oil and toasted slivered almonds.
tips: Apricots and culinary lavender are classic southern French orchard partners that taste naturally sweet with no refined sugar.
Use clean kitchen shears to snip apricots and dates quickly with minimal wrist strain.

recipes.title: London Fog Black Tea, Culinary Lavender & Banana Barley Bowl
recipes.summary: Cozy café-inspired morning bowl warming tender pearl barley in Earl Grey-style black tea and oat milk gently infused with culinary lavender, mashed banana, cinnamon, and sliced almonds.

ingredient_details.note: steeped with black tea and strained cleanly

ingredient_details.item: black tea bag (such as Earl Grey or Assam)

steps: Steep the black tea bag and 1/4 tsp culinary lavender buds together in 3/4 cup boiling water covered for 4 minutes, then strain cleanly.
Simmer cooked pearl barley with the brewed tea, oat milk, mashed banana, and cinnamon over medium-low heat 8 minutes until velvety.
Ladle into two bowls and top with sliced banana, fresh orange zest, and toasted sliced almonds.
tips: Use decaf black tea if you prefer to keep breakfast caffeine-free while keeping the classic London Fog warmth.
Orange zest echoes the bergamot citrus note of Earl Grey tea effortlessly.

recipes.title: Chilled Blackberry, Culinary Lavender & Chia Overnight Parfait
recipes.summary: No-cook make-ahead chia parfait set in softly steeped culinary lavender almond milk and crowned with juicy blackberries, wild blueberries, snipped lemon balm, and toasted almonds.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/4 cup warm water 4 minutes, strained and cooled

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1/4 cup hot water 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and stir into almond milk and maple syrup.
Whisk in chia seeds thoroughly, wait 5 minutes, whisk once more so no lumps form, and pour into two jars.
Chill overnight until spoonably thick and silky.
Top with blackberries, wild blueberries, chopped toasted almonds, and snipped fresh lemon balm right before eating.
tips: Always confirm your lavender jar says 'culinary' or 'Lavandula angustifolia' on the label.
Wide-mouth jars stay stable on the counter and let you prep two mornings at once.

recipes.title: Silky Culinary Lavender, Honeycrisp Apple & Fennel Morning Polenta
recipes.summary: Velvety golden breakfast polenta whisked into lavender-and-fennel infused water, folded with warm cinnamon-sautéed Honeycrisp apples, toasted almonds, and cold-pressed walnut oil.

ingredient_details.note: steeped with fennel seed in hot water and strained cleanly
steeped alongside lavender and strained out

steps: Steep culinary lavender buds and lightly crushed fennel seeds in 1 1/2 cups boiling water covered 4 minutes, then lift out the infuser cleanly.
Bring the strained aromatic water and oat milk to a gentle simmer, whisk in fine polenta, and cook over low heat 8 to 10 minutes until thick and tender.
Fold diced Honeycrisp apple and cinnamon into the pot during the last 3 minutes so the fruit softens slightly.
Spoon into warm bowls and drizzle with cold-pressed walnut oil and toasted sliced almonds.
tips: Steeping fennel and lavender together gives a gentle Provençal bakery perfume with zero floating seeds.
Soft warm polenta is easy to chew and deeply comforting on cool mornings.

recipes.title: French Lavender-Scented Raspberry, Dark Chocolate & Buckwheat Crepes
recipes.summary: Delicate buckwheat crepes infused with a whisper of culinary lavender and orange zest, folded warm over lightly crushed raspberries, shaved dark chocolate, and toasted almonds.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm oat milk 4 minutes and strained

steps: Warm oat milk with 1/4 tsp culinary lavender buds inside a tea infuser for 4 minutes, remove infuser cleanly, and cool slightly.
Whisk buckwheat flour, egg, lavender oat milk, almond oil, and orange zest into a smooth thin batter.
Cook four thin crepes in a lightly oiled 8-inch nonstick skillet, about 90 seconds per side.
Scatter shaved dark chocolate, fresh raspberries, and toasted almonds over each warm crepe and fold gently.
tips: Infusing the liquid and discarding the buds gives an even, elegant floral note with no bitter bite from chewing a whole bud.
Using a compact 8-inch skillet keeps flipping light and controlled.

recipes.title: Herbes de Provence Lavender, Button Mushroom & Thyme Soft Scramble
recipes.summary: Savory Provençal breakfast skillet sautéing button mushrooms in extra-virgin olive oil with thyme, rosemary, and a tiny finely crushed pinch of culinary lavender before folding in soft eggs.

ingredient_details.note: finely crushed with thyme and rosemary into a mini herbes de Provence blend

steps: Rub culinary lavender buds, thyme, and minced rosemary lightly between your fingers or crush briefly with the back of a spoon.
Warm olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté sliced button mushrooms with the Provençal herbs for 4 to 5 minutes until golden and tender.
Reduce heat to medium-low, pour in whisked eggs, and fold gently for 2 to 3 minutes until glossy, soft curds form.
Season with cracked black pepper and serve alongside fresh baby arugula.
tips: In classic savory herbes de Provence, culinary lavender stays a subtle background whisper (1/8 tsp) alongside thyme and rosemary.
Pre-sliced mushrooms make this an effortless 10-minute high-protein breakfast.

recipes.title: Cozy Sweet Cherry, Culinary Lavender & Orange Brown Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Warm cooked brown rice simmered in lavender-infused almond milk with sweet pitted cherries, warm cinnamon, orange zest, and chopped roasted cashews.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm almond milk inside an infuser and removed

steps: Warm almond milk gently with 1/4 tsp culinary lavender buds in a tea infuser for 4 minutes, then lift out and discard buds.
Add cooked brown rice, cinnamon, and honey to the fragrant milk and simmer 7 to 8 minutes until creamy.
Stir in pitted cherries for the last 2 minutes until warm and juicy.
Spoon into warm bowls and top with fresh orange zest and chopped roasted cashews.
tips: Frozen pitted sweet cherries need no pitting or chopping and warm right in the pan.
Whole-grain brown rice offers steady slow-release morning energy.

recipes.title: Lavender-Honey Cantaloupe, Spearmint & Almond Butter Toast
recipes.summary: Crisp whole-grain toast layered with creamy almond butter, ripe cantaloupe slices, wild blueberries, fresh spearmint, walnut oil, and a delicate drizzle of steeped lavender honey.

ingredient_details.note: warmed gently in honey 3 minutes and strained

steps: Warm honey with 1/4 tsp culinary lavender buds over the lowest heat for 2 to 3 minutes without boiling, let sit 2 minutes, and strain cleanly through a tea strainer.
Toast whole-grain bread slices and spread generously with smooth almond butter.
Arrange thin cantaloupe slices and fresh blueberries over the almond butter.
Finish with snipped spearmint, a light drizzle of walnut oil, and 1 to 2 tsp of the strained lavender honey (save extra in a small jar).
tips: Infusing a small jar of lavender honey once lets you drizzle effortless floral sweetness over breakfasts all month.
Use pre-sliced cantaloupe for a quick, knife-light morning assembly.

recipes.title: Café Lavender, Cold-Brew Coffee, Date & Almond Baked-Style Oats
recipes.summary: Velvety café-inspired morning oats cooked in smooth brewed coffee and oat milk lightly infused with culinary lavender, mashed banana, chopped Medjool dates, cinnamon, and toasted almonds.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm oat milk 4 minutes and strained cleanly

ingredient_details.item: smooth brewed coffee or diluted cold-brew coffee

steps: Warm oat milk gently with 1/4 tsp culinary lavender inside a tea infuser for 4 minutes, then lift out the infuser cleanly.
Stir in brewed coffee, rolled oats, mashed banana, chopped dates, and cinnamon.
Simmer gently 6 to 7 minutes until thick, mocha-golden, and fragrant.
Spoon into two bowls and crown with toasted sliced almonds.
tips: Lavender-vanilla lattes are a café favorite—putting those same gentle notes into warm oats makes breakfast feel like a treat.
Decaf coffee works identically if you prefer an afternoon-friendly bowl.

recipes.title: Crisp Orange, Fennel & Chickpea Arugula Salad with Lavender Vinaigrette
recipes.summary: Bright Provençal salad tossing tender chickpeas, peppery arugula, sweet orange segments, and toasted almonds in a lightly steeped culinary lavender, fennel seed, and olive oil vinaigrette.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm lemon juice 4 minutes and strained cleanly

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender buds in 1 tbsp warm water and lemon juice for 4 minutes, then strain through a tea strainer into a screw-top jar.
Add extra-virgin olive oil, fresh orange juice, crushed fennel seed, and a pinch of salt to the jar and shake briskly until emulsified.
Toss chickpeas, baby arugula, and sweet orange segments in a large bowl with the fragrant citrus-lavender dressing.
Divide into two wide bowls and top with toasted sliced almonds.
tips: Steeping and straining lavender into the dressing base prevents biting into whole dried flower buds in a crisp salad.
Shaking vinaigrette in a tight-lid jar is quick and gentle on the wrists.

recipes.title: Herbes de Provence Lavender Chicken, Carrot & Pearl Barley Bowl
recipes.summary: Tender chicken strips and sweet carrot coins sautéed in olive oil with thyme, rosemary, and a subtle pinch of ground culinary lavender, spooned warm over nutty pearl barley.

ingredient_details.note: finely ground with thyme and rosemary

steps: Crush culinary lavender finely with thyme and rosemary using the back of a spoon.
Warm olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté chicken pieces and carrot coins with the Provençal herb rub for 4 minutes.
Pour in low-sodium chicken broth, cover, and simmer 8 minutes until carrots are tender and chicken is juicy (165 F).
Spoon the savory chicken, sweet carrots, and aromatic pan jus over warm cooked pearl barley.
tips: Blending culinary lavender into a classic rosemary-thyme Provençal rub keeps it distinctly savory and grounded.
Use pre-sliced carrot coins and chicken tenders to keep knife work minimal.

recipes.title: Ruby Beetroot, Blackberry & Arugula Salad with Lavender-Walnut Dressing
recipes.summary: Jewel-toned lunch salad combining tender steamed ruby beetroot, fresh blackberries, peppery arugula, fresh thyme, and toasted almonds in a culinary lavender walnut-oil dressing.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm cider vinegar 4 minutes and strained

steps: Warm apple cider vinegar with 1 tbsp water and 1/4 tsp culinary lavender buds for 30 seconds, steep 4 minutes, and strain cleanly into a jar.
Add cold-pressed walnut oil, fresh thyme leaves, and a pinch of salt and shake well.
Arrange baby arugula, beetroot wedges, and fresh blackberries in two wide bowls.
Drizzle generously with the lavender-walnut vinaigrette and scatter toasted sliced almonds on top.
tips: Ready-to-eat vacuum-packed steamed beets make this jewel-colored lunch completely no-cook.
Blackberries, beets, and walnut oil share deep earthy-floral tones that harmonize effortlessly with lavender.

recipes.title: Provençal Lavender, Artichoke, Asparagus & Summer Savory Broth Bowl
recipes.summary: Light, herbaceous southern-French garden soup simmering tender asparagus, quartered artichoke hearts, celery stalk, summer savory, olive oil, and a delicate infusion of culinary lavender.

ingredient_details.note: sealed in a tea infuser with summer savory

steps: Warm olive oil in a pot over medium-low heat and soften sliced celery stalks for 4 minutes.
Pour in low-sodium vegetable broth and add quartered artichoke hearts; drop in a clamped tea infuser holding 1/4 tsp culinary lavender and summer savory.
Simmer gently 6 minutes, add asparagus pieces, and cook 4 minutes more until bright green and tender.
Lift out the herb infuser cleanly, season with cracked black pepper, and ladle into warm bowls with a light olive-oil finish.
tips: Using a tea infuser as an instant bouquet garni lets you remove lavender buds cleanly before serving.
Hydrating, low-effort, and richly aromatic with authentic Provençal greens.

recipes.title: Lavender-Olive Oil Flaked Salmon, Apricot & Tarragon Brown Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Warm nutty brown rice crowned with moist flaked salmon, crisp cucumber, snipped apricots, and fresh tarragon drizzled with warm culinary lavender-infused extra-virgin olive oil.

ingredient_details.note: gently warmed in olive oil and strained cleanly

steps: Warm extra-virgin olive oil with 1/4 tsp culinary lavender buds over the lowest heat for 2 minutes until gently fragrant, let rest 2 minutes off heat, and strain cleanly.
Whisk fresh lemon juice and a pinch of salt into the warm lavender oil.
Arrange warm brown rice, diced cucumber, snipped apricots, and flaked salmon in two shallow bowls.
Spoon the lavender-lemon olive oil over top and scatter snipped fresh tarragon across each bowl.
tips: Never let lavender oil sizzle or smoke—gentle low heat extracts sweet herbal notes without bitterness.
A wonderful next-day lunch using leftover cooked salmon and microwaveable brown rice.

recipes.title: Velvety Butternut Squash, Sage & Whisper-of-Lavender White Bean Soup
recipes.summary: Creamy golden soup blending sweet butternut squash, white beans, raw cashews, fresh sage, thyme, cracked black pepper, and a gentle tea-ball infusion of culinary lavender.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in a tea infuser during simmering and removed before blending

steps: Warm olive oil in a soup pot and sauté fresh sage and thyme for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced butternut squash, cannellini beans, raw cashews, vegetable broth, and a clamped tea infuser holding 1/4 tsp culinary lavender.
Simmer covered 16 minutes until squash is completely soft, then lift out the lavender infuser cleanly.
Blend right inside the pot with an immersion blender until velvety smooth, season with cracked black pepper, and serve warm.
tips: Always remove the lavender infuser before blending so the soup stays delicately aromatic rather than bitter.
An immersion blender avoids pouring scalding soup into a countertop blender.

recipes.title: Chilled Lavender-Mint Cucumber, Sweet Grape & Buckwheat Salad
recipes.summary: Refreshing warm-weather grain salad combining cooked cooled buckwheat groats, crisp cucumber, halved sweet grapes, celery stalk, fresh spearmint, and culinary lavender almond-oil dressing.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm lime juice and strained

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1 tbsp warm water and lime juice for 4 minutes, then strain cleanly into a small jar.
Add sweet culinary almond oil and a pinch of salt and shake until lightly thickened.
Combine cooled buckwheat groats, diced cucumber, halved grapes, sliced celery stalk, and snipped spearmint in a bowl.
Toss gently with the lavender-lime dressing and serve cool.
tips: Sweet grapes and cool cucumber highlight lavender's garden freshness without feeling heavy.
Batch-cooked buckwheat chills cleanly in the fridge without clumping.

recipes.title: Provençal Lavender-Thyme Roasted Bell Pepper & Chickpea Sourdough Toast
recipes.summary: Open-faced crusty sourdough topped with warm olive-oil mashed chickpeas and sweet bell peppers gently scented with thyme, fresh basil, cracked black pepper, and a pinch of ground culinary lavender.

ingredient_details.item: jarred roasted red bell peppers or finely diced sweet bell pepper

steps: Warm olive oil in a small skillet over medium-low heat and sauté bell pepper strips with thyme and 1/8 tsp finely crushed culinary lavender for 3 minutes.
Add drained chickpeas and 2 tbsp water, warm 3 minutes, and mash coarsely with a fork right in the skillet so it becomes spreadable.
Season with cracked black pepper and a pinch of salt.
Pile generously onto warm toasted sourdough slices and scatter torn fresh basil on top.
tips: Jarred water-packed roasted red bell peppers cut prep to 2 minutes and bring smoky Provençal sweetness.
Mashing the chickpeas lightly keeps every bite securely on the toast.

recipes.title: Poached Chicken, Apple & Broccoli Salad with Lavender-Lemon Dressing
recipes.summary: Tender shredded chicken, lightly steamed broccoli florets, crisp apple, and celery stalk tossed in a silky culinary lavender, dill seed, lemon, and cold-pressed sunflower oil dressing.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm lemon juice 4 minutes and strained

steps: Steam small broccoli florets in a covered skillet with 3 tbsp water for 3 minutes until bright green and tender; rinse cool and pat dry.
Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1 tbsp warm water and lemon juice 4 minutes, strain into a jar, and shake with sunflower oil, crushed dill seed, and a pinch of salt.
Combine shredded chicken, cooled broccoli, diced apple, and sliced celery stalk in a bowl.
Toss gently with the bright lavender-dill dressing and serve chilled or at room temperature.
tips: Briefly steaming broccoli florets makes this crisp salad comfortable to chew and gentle on digestion.
Use kitchen shears to snip pre-cooked chicken breasts cleanly without wrestling a cutting board.

recipes.title: Rustic Provençal Lavender, Mushroom, Bay Leaf & Barley Lunch Pot
recipes.summary: Hearty French-countryside one-pot lunch simmering golden olive-oil mushrooms, sweet carrots, pearl barley, fresh thyme, bay leaf, and a delicate bouquet-garni steep of culinary lavender.

ingredient_details.note: held inside a clamped tea infuser during simmering

equipment: Medium Dutch oven or soup pot
steps: Sauté sliced button mushrooms and carrots in olive oil over medium heat for 6 minutes until lightly browned.
Stir in fresh thyme, cooked pearl barley, vegetable broth, bay leaf, and a clamped tea infuser holding 1/4 tsp culinary lavender.
Simmer gently uncovered 10 to 12 minutes until carrots are spoon-tender and broth is rich.
Remove both the bay leaf and lavender infuser cleanly and ladle warm into two bowls.
tips: Containment in a tea ball lets culinary lavender scent savory stews cleanly just like a traditional Provençal sachet.
Leftovers thicken gently overnight into a cozy next-day meal.

recipes.title: Classic Provençal Lavender, Rosemary & Thyme Roasted Chicken with Carrots
recipes.summary: Juicy boneless chicken thighs and sweet carrot batons roasted on one parchment-lined sheet pan with extra-virgin olive oil and an authentic homemade herbes de Provence blend with culinary lavender.

ingredient_details.note: finely crushed into the Provençal herb rub

ingredient_details.item: baby carrots or peeled carrot batons

steps: Heat oven to 400 F and line a rimmed sheet pan with parchment paper.
Crush 1/2 tsp culinary lavender with rosemary, thyme, summer savory, and cracked black pepper in a small bowl, then stir into extra-virgin olive oil.
Toss chicken thighs and carrots evenly with the Provençal herb oil and arrange in a single layer on the sheet pan.
Roast 26 to 28 minutes until carrots are caramelized and chicken reaches 165 F, spooning warm herb juices over top before serving.
tips: Pairing 1/2 tsp lavender across a full pound of chicken plus carrots alongside rosemary, thyme, and summer savory delivers classic bistro flavor—never soapy.
Baby carrots skip peeling and slicing while roasting up tender and sweet.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Lavender-Honey Roasted Butternut Squash, Chickpeas & Sage
recipes.summary: Caramelized cubed butternut squash and golden chickpeas roasted with olive oil, crisp fresh sage, sweet orange zest, toasted almonds, and a post-oven glaze of warm culinary lavender honey.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm honey and orange juice, then strained cleanly

steps: Heat oven to 400 F. Toss cubed butternut squash, patted-dry chickpeas, sage leaves, olive oil, and a pinch of salt on a parchment-lined sheet pan.
Roast 22 to 24 minutes until squash is golden-tender and sage leaves turn delicate and crisp.
While roasting, warm honey, orange juice, and 1/4 tsp culinary lavender gently 3 minutes without boiling, steep 2 minutes, and strain cleanly.
Drizzle the warm lavender-orange honey glaze over the roasted squash and chickpeas and finish with orange zest and toasted almonds.
tips: Drizzling strained lavender-honey after roasting keeps the honey from scorching and preserves every floral note.
Pre-cubed squash makes this a true 5-minute prep dinner.

recipes.title: Herbes de Provence Lavender-Fennel Baked Salmon with Asparagus
recipes.summary: Flaky oven-baked salmon fillets and tender asparagus spears brushed with extra-virgin olive oil infused with crushed fennel seed, thyme, cracked black pepper, and a gentle touch of culinary lavender.

ingredient_details.note: finely crushed with fennel seed and thyme

steps: Heat oven to 400 F. Crush 1/4 tsp culinary lavender with fennel seed, fresh thyme, and black pepper and stir into olive oil.
Arrange salmon fillets and trimmed asparagus on a parchment-lined sheet pan and brush generously with the Provençal herb oil.
Bake 12 to 14 minutes until salmon flakes effortlessly with a fork and asparagus is tender-bright.
Finish with a bright squeeze of fresh lemon juice right before plating.
tips: Baking salmon and asparagus side-by-side on parchment means one pan, 14 minutes, and zero stove-side splattering.
Fennel seed and lemon soften the floral lift of lavender into pure Mediterranean harmony.

recipes.title: Caramelized Brussels Sprouts, Beetroot & Lavender-Caraway Barley
recipes.summary: Roasted halved Brussels sprouts and sweet beetroot tossed over nutty pearl barley with caraway seeds, fresh thyme, cold-pressed walnut oil, and a delicate lavender-cider reduction.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm apple cider vinegar and strained

steps: Heat oven to 400 F. Toss halved Brussels sprouts with olive oil, caraway seeds, thyme, and a pinch of salt on a parchment-lined sheet pan and roast 18 minutes.
Add cooked beetroot cubes to the pan for the final 4 minutes just to warm through and caramelize lightly.
Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in warm apple cider vinegar with 1 tbsp water for 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and whisk in cold-pressed walnut oil.
Pile warm pearl barley in two bowls, top with roasted sprouts and ruby beets, and drizzle generously with the lavender-walnut dressing.
tips: Roast with olive oil and finish with walnut oil after baking so walnut oil's delicate nutty notes stay bright.
Pre-halved Brussels sprouts and steamed beets cut prep effort in half.

recipes.title: Fragrant Lavender, Apricot & Coriander Braised Chicken over Brown Rice
recipes.summary: Tender skillet chicken braised in low-sodium broth with golden apricots, celery stalk, warm ground coriander seed, and a clean tea-ball steep of culinary lavender, spooned over brown rice.

ingredient_details.note: steeped inside a clamped tea infuser during braising

steps: Warm olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sauté sliced celery stalk and ground coriander seed for 3 minutes until aromatic.
Lay chicken strips and halved apricots in the pan, pour in low-sodium chicken broth, and tuck in a clamped tea infuser holding 1/4 tsp culinary lavender.
Cover tightly and braise gently over low heat 12 minutes until chicken is moist and cooked through (165 F) and apricots are plump.
Lift out the lavender infuser cleanly and serve the chicken, apricots, and silky golden jus over warm brown rice.
tips: Braising with an enclosed tea infuser infuses the entire pan sauce evenly and lifts out in one clean motion.
Warm coriander seed bridges sweet apricots and floral lavender beautifully.

recipes.title: Provençal Lavender-Basil Simmered Bell Pepper, Mushroom & Chickpea Ragout
recipes.summary: Sun-warmed ratatouille-inspired skillet stew simmering sweet bell peppers, button mushrooms, chickpeas, fresh thyme, sweet basil, olive oil, and a tiny whisper of culinary lavender.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in a tea infuser while simmering and removed cleanly

ingredient_details.item: diced red and yellow sweet bell peppers

equipment: Wide skillet or sauté pan with lid
steps: Sauté diced bell peppers and sliced button mushrooms in extra-virgin olive oil over medium heat for 6 minutes until soft and lightly golden.
Stir in chickpeas, diced tomatoes, fresh thyme, and 1/4 cup water; nestle a clamped tea infuser with 1/4 tsp culinary lavender into the sauce.
Cover and simmer gently 10 to 12 minutes until rich and spoon-soft.
Lift out the lavender infuser cleanly, fold in torn sweet basil, and serve warm with crusty bread or brown rice.
tips: Using a clamped tea infuser keeps the lavender subtle and stops buds from getting lost in the tomato sauce.
Even more flavorful the next day after the Provençal herbs meld.

recipes.title: Provençal Lavender, Rosemary & Cracked Pepper Beef Strips with Broccoli
recipes.summary: Tender sliced lean sirloin quickly seared with rosemary, cracked black pepper, bay leaf, and a subtle Provençal pinch of ground culinary lavender, served alongside crisp-tender olive-oil broccoli.

ingredient_details.note: finely ground with rosemary and black pepper

steps: Steam small broccoli florets in a covered skillet with 1/4 cup water for 3 minutes until emerald and tender; drain and set aside with 1/2 tbsp olive oil.

Wipe the skillet dry, warm remaining 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat, and sear thin sirloin strips seasoned with ground culinary lavender, minced rosemary, and cracked black pepper for 2 minutes.
Add low-sodium beef broth and the bay leaf, reduce heat to low, and simmer gently 5 minutes until glossy and tender.
Discard the bay leaf and plate the savory beef strips and pan jus alongside the warm broccoli.
tips: Cracked black pepper and woody rosemary anchor culinary lavender into a deeply savory steakhouse crust.
Ask your grocery butcher to slice sirloin thin so dinner cooks fast and stays effortlessly tender.

recipes.title: Marseille-Style Clams in Fennel, Tarragon & Whisper-of-Lavender Broth
recipes.summary: Sweet littleneck clams steamed open in a coastal Provençal broth of olive oil, celery stalk, crushed fennel seed, fresh tarragon, lemon, and an enclosed steep of culinary lavender.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm broth inside a tea infuser and removed cleanly
or 10 oz canned whole baby clams with clam broth

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender inside a tea infuser in 1 cup hot water for 4 minutes, then lift out cleanly.
Sauté finely diced celery stalk and crushed fennel seeds in olive oil for 3 minutes until aromatic.
Pour in the delicate lavender infusion and lemon juice, bring to a simmer, add scrubbed clams, cover, and steam 5 to 6 minutes until all shells open (discard any closed shells).
Finish with snipped fresh tarragon and cracked black pepper and ladle into warm bowls.
tips: Using strained lavender water gives Marseille-style shellfish a bright coastal aroma with zero stray herbs on the shells.
Jarred whole baby clams warm in 2 minutes for an extra-easy weeknight swap.

recipes.title: One-Pan Lavender, Artichoke, Mushroom & Summer Savory Buckwheat Skillet
recipes.summary: Savory toasted buckwheat groats cooked directly in olive oil and vegetable broth with browned button mushrooms, quartered artichoke hearts, thyme, summer savory, and culinary lavender.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm broth inside an infuser and removed cleanly

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender inside a tea infuser in hot vegetable broth for 4 minutes, then lift out cleanly.
Sauté sliced button mushrooms and quartered artichoke hearts in olive oil over medium heat for 5 minutes until edges caramelize.
Stir in rinsed buckwheat groats, summer savory, fresh thyme, and the fragrant strained vegetable broth; bring to a simmer.
Cover tightly, lower heat, and steam 12 minutes until buckwheat is fluffy and tender; fluff gently with a fork and serve.
tips: Steeping lavender in the broth first infuses every single grain of buckwheat softly and evenly.
Pre-sliced mushrooms and jarred artichokes keep cutting-board time under 3 minutes.

recipes.title: Lavender-Citrus Glazed Baked Salmon over Silky Sage Butternut Mash
recipes.summary: Tender roasted salmon brushed with a light culinary lavender-orange glaze and served over velvety olive-oil mashed butternut squash scented with fresh sage and a pinch of cinnamon.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in warm orange juice and honey, then strained cleanly

steps: Heat oven to 400 F. Simmer diced butternut squash in a covered saucepan with 1/2 cup water 12 minutes until completely soft; drain well and mash smoothly with 1 tbsp olive oil, snipped sage, cinnamon, and a pinch of salt.
Simmer orange juice, honey, and 1/4 tsp culinary lavender 3 minutes until glossy, then strain cleanly through a tea strainer.
Brush salmon fillets with remaining 1/2 tbsp olive oil and half the strained lavender-orange glaze and bake on parchment 11 to 13 minutes until flaky.
Spoon silky sage butternut mash onto warm plates, rest the glazed salmon on top, and drizzle with remaining glaze and orange zest.
tips: Soft mashed butternut squash and flaky baked salmon create an easy-to-eat, high-comfort gourmet dinner.
Keep the lavender strictly at 1/4 tsp and always strain so the citrus glaze stays sparkling smooth.

recipes.title: Velvety Blackberry, Culinary Lavender, Banana & Almond Cream Smoothie
recipes.summary: Plush deep-violet smoothie blending chilled lightly steeped culinary lavender infusion, almond milk, frozen blackberries, ripe banana, almond butter, chia seed, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/4 cup hot water 4 minutes, strained cleanly and chilled

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp food-grade culinary lavender in 1/4 cup boiling water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Pour chilled lavender infusion and almond milk into a blender jar.
Add frozen blackberries, ripe banana, almond butter, chia seeds, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.
Blend on high 50 seconds until lush purple and velvety smooth; serve immediately.
tips: Always steep and strain lavender into a small chilled concentrate rather than tossing dry buds directly into the blender—it tastes silky and floral, never bitter or soapy.
Steep 1 tsp buds in 1 cup water once on Sunday and chill in a small bottle so four smoothies are ready to pour all week.

recipes.title: Twilight Wild Blueberry, Culinary Lavender & Chamomile Cashew Smoothie
recipes.summary: Calming evening berry smoothie uniting chilled chamomile-lavender infusion, wild blueberries, raw soaked cashews, sweet banana, and a light dusting of Ceylon cinnamon.

ingredient_details.note: steeped alongside chamomile tea and strained cleanly
soaked 10 minutes in warm water and drained

steps: Steep 1 chamomile tea bag and 1/8 tsp culinary lavender in 3/4 cup boiling water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Blend the chilled floral tea and drained cashews 20 seconds until creamy.
Add frozen wild blueberries, ripe banana, and cinnamon, and blend 40 seconds more until deep indigo and satin-smooth.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy slowly.
tips: Combining a light 1/8 tsp pinch of lavender with honeyed chamomile delivers a gentle spa-like twilight aroma.
Naturally caffeine-free and dairy-free for restful evenings.

recipes.title: Chilled London Fog Black Tea, Culinary Lavender & Almond Smoothie
recipes.summary: Creamy café-style shake blending chilled Earl Grey-style black tea steeped with culinary lavender, oat milk, frozen banana, Medjool date, almond butter, and warm cinnamon.

ingredient_details.note: steeped with black tea 4 minutes, strained cleanly and chilled

ingredient_details.item: chilled strong brewed Earl Grey or Assam black tea

steps: Steep 1 black tea bag and 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1/2 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Add chilled lavender black tea, oat milk, frozen banana chunks, almond butter, pitted date, and cinnamon to the blender.
Blend on high 45 seconds until thick, frothy, and velvety like a chilled café frappe.
Serve immediately in a chilled glass.
tips: Use decaf Earl Grey for an identical creamy London Fog treat any time of day.
Freeze peeled ripe banana halves in a labeled zip bag so smoothies turn milkshake-thick with zero ice.

recipes.title: Provençal Apricot, Sweet Orange, Culinary Lavender & Cashew Smoothie
recipes.summary: Sunlit Mediterranean smoothie blending chilled culinary lavender water, sweet navel orange, plump apricots, creamy soaked cashews, fresh ginger, and chia seeds.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes, strained and chilled
soaked 10 minutes in warm water and drained

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1/2 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, lift out the infuser cleanly, and chill.
Combine chilled lavender water, drained cashews, peeled orange segments, apricots, grated ginger, chia seeds, and ice in the blender.
Blend on high 55 seconds until glowing sunset-gold and smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy cold.
tips: Fresh sweet orange juice and zest lift culinary lavender's bright herbal character without tasting perfumey.
Soaking cashews briefly lets them whirl into velvety dairy-free richness.

recipes.title: Silky Raspberry, Dark Chocolate, Culinary Lavender & Date Smoothie
recipes.summary: Artisan confection-inspired smoothie swirling chilled culinary lavender infusion, creamy oat milk, frozen raspberries, dark chocolate, almond butter, and sweet Medjool date.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/4 cup hot water 4 minutes, strained and chilled
finely chopped, or 1 tbsp unsweetened dark cocoa

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1/4 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Combine chilled lavender infusion, creamy oat milk, frozen raspberries, dark chocolate, pitted Medjool date, almond butter, and cinnamon in a blender.
Blend on high 55 seconds until deep berry-cocoa smooth.
Pour into a tall glass and sip right away.
tips: Dark chocolate, tart raspberry, and a subtle whisper of lavender mimic an upscale French patisserie truffle in nourishing drinkable form.
Swap in unsweetened dark cocoa powder for zero chocolate specks if preferred.

recipes.title: Evening Tart Cherry, Culinary Lavender, Buckwheat & Almond Oil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Nourishing ruby-violet smoothie blending chilled lavender infusion, almond milk, frozen tart cherries, ripe banana, cooled cooked buckwheat groats, cinnamon, and sweet almond oil.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/4 cup hot water 4 minutes, strained and chilled

ingredient_details.item: frozen pitted tart or dark cherries

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1/4 cup boiling water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Add chilled lavender water, almond milk, frozen cherries, banana, cooked chilled buckwheat groats, culinary almond oil, and cinnamon to a blender.
Blend on high 55 seconds until completely creamy and ruby-smooth.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy.
tips: A scoop of leftover cooked buckwheat adds subtle toasted nuttiness and gentle whole-grain fiber.
Tart cherries and lavender make a tranquil, naturally caffeine-free evening blend.

recipes.title: Café Lavender Cold-Brew Coffee, Banana, Date & Cashew Smoothie
recipes.summary: Morning pick-me-up smoothie blending smooth cold-brew coffee, lightly steeped culinary lavender water, almond milk, frozen banana, Medjool date, raw cashews, and cinnamon.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/4 cup hot water 4 minutes, strained and chilled
soaked 10 minutes in warm water and drained

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1/4 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and cool.
Combine chilled lavender water, cold-brew coffee, almond milk, drained cashews, frozen banana, pitted date, and cinnamon in a blender.
Blend on high 50 seconds until frosty, mocha-creamy, and smooth.
Serve immediately in a tall glass.
tips: Keep a bottle of ready-to-pour cold-brew coffee in the fridge for 2-minute café smoothies with zero brewing clutter.
Medjool date and frozen banana sweeten coffee naturally without syrups.

recipes.title: Chilled Purple Grape, Cantaloupe, Culinary Lavender & Lemon Balm Smoothie
recipes.summary: Light summer garden smoothie blending chilled culinary lavender infusion, frozen purple grapes, ripe cantaloupe, fresh lemon balm leaves, chia seeds, and sliced almonds.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes, strained and chilled

ingredient_details.item: frozen seedless red or purple grapes

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1/2 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, lift out infuser cleanly, and chill.
Combine chilled lavender water, frozen purple grapes, cantaloupe cubes, fresh lemon balm leaves, chia seeds, and blanched almonds in the blender.
Blend on high 50 seconds until silky rose-lavender and refreshingly frosty.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Frozen grapes act as naturally sweet ice cubes while keeping the smoothie vibrant and lush.
Lemon balm lends a sunny citrus lift that keeps lavender light and refreshing.

recipes.title: Rosy Beetroot, Crisp Apple, Blueberry & Culinary Lavender Smoothie
recipes.summary: Vibrant magenta antioxidant smoothie blending chilled culinary lavender infusion, steamed ruby beetroot, crisp apple, wild blueberries, ginger, raw cashews, and cold-pressed flaxseed oil.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes, strained and chilled

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1/2 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Pour chilled lavender water and cold water into the blender with soaked cashews and blend 15 seconds until smooth.
Add steamed chilled beetroot, cored apple, frozen wild blueberries, grated ginger, and flaxseed oil.
Blend on high 55 seconds until brilliant magenta and velvety smooth.
tips: Ready-cooked vacuum-packed beets drop straight into the blender with zero peeling or messy raw beet juice.
Sweet apple and wild blueberries round out earthy beetroot gracefully.

recipes.title: Botanical Cucumber, Spearmint, Culinary Lavender & Brazil Nut Smoothie
recipes.summary: Cool, creamy garden-spa smoothie blending chilled culinary lavender infusion, crisp cucumber, fresh spearmint, sweet apple, frozen banana, chia seed, and 1 soaked Brazil nut.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes, strained and chilled
soaked 10 minutes in warm water and drained

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1/2 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Blend chilled lavender water, cold water, and the soaked Brazil nut 20 seconds until lightly milky.
Add cucumber chunks, fresh spearmint, cored apple, frozen banana, and chia seeds.
Blend on high 45 seconds until cool, frothy pale green, and smooth.
tips: Spearmint and cucumber highlight lavender's cool botanical freshness like an iced spa refresher.
Keep Brazil nuts to 1 per glass for rich creaminess and natural selenium balance.

recipes.title: Classic Provençal Honey-Lavender Lemonade with Orange & Lemon Balm
recipes.summary: Crisp, balanced lavender lemonade pouring freshly squeezed lemon, sweet orange, and crisp apple juices into lightly steeped culinary lavender tea with honey, ginger, and clapped lemon balm.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1 cup hot water 4 minutes, strained cleanly and chilled

steps: Steep 1/2 tsp culinary lavender buds in 1 cup just-boiled water covered for exactly 4 minutes, lift out the infuser cleanly, stir in honey until dissolved, and chill.
Combine chilled lavender honey tea, fresh lemon juice, sweet orange juice, pure apple juice, and ginger juice in a pitcher.
Fill two tall glasses with ice and lightly clapped lemon balm leaves.
Pour the bright golden-rose lemonade over ice and serve cold.
tips: Timing the steep to 4 minutes and capping at 1/2 tsp for two full glasses yields crisp lemonade house flavor—never soapy.
Sweet orange and apple juice cut the amount of sweetener needed while keeping the citrus vibrant.

recipes.title: Sparkling Wild Blueberry, Culinary Lavender & Spearmint Spritzer
recipes.summary: Luminous amethyst spritzer pressing sweet wild blueberries and cool spearmint into chilled culinary lavender infusion with apple juice, fresh ginger, lime, and sparkling water.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes, strained and chilled

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1/2 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Pulse the chilled lavender infusion with wild blueberries, pure apple juice, spearmint leaves, grated ginger, and lime juice for 15 seconds.
Strain smoothly over a tall glass of ice cubes using a resting mesh strainer.
Top gently with chilled sparkling water and give one soft stir.
tips: Still cold water swaps seamlessly for sparkling water if bubbles irritate swallowing.
Pulsing berries and straining releases vivid sapphire-violet color with zero hand-muddling effort.

recipes.title: Deep Violet Blackberry, Concord Grape & Culinary Lavender Press
recipes.summary: Velvety evening berry cooler blending and straining chilled culinary lavender-cinnamon infusion with juicy blackberries, pure Concord grape juice, apple juice, and fresh lemon balm.

ingredient_details.note: steeped with cinnamon stick 4 minutes, strained and chilled

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender and a small cinnamon stick in 1/2 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain completely, and chill.
Pulse chilled spiced lavender infusion with blackberries, Concord grape juice, apple juice, and lemon balm 15 seconds.
Strain through a fine-mesh strainer directly over ice cubes to catch blackberry seeds cleanly.
Serve immediately while jewel-bright and cold.
tips: Using a whole cinnamon stick instead of powder keeps the finished press crystal-smooth.
Naturally caffeine-free and rich in deep purple berry polyphenols.

recipes.title: Spa-Crisp Cucumber, Celery, Green Apple & Culinary Lavender Tonic
recipes.summary: Ultra-refreshing botanical green press blending and straining chilled culinary lavender water with crisp English cucumber, celery stalk, tart green apple, fresh spearmint, and ginger.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes, strained and chilled

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1/2 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Blend chilled lavender infusion, chopped cucumber, celery stalk, cored green apple, spearmint leaves, and ginger on high 30 seconds.
Pour through a fine-mesh strainer resting over a wide bowl, pressing gently with a spoon to collect the crisp green juice.
Pour over ice cubes and sip chilled.
tips: A blender plus wide mesh strainer rinses clean in 20 seconds—much simpler than disassembling an electric juicer.
Hydrating, crisp, and gently floral with low natural sugar.

recipes.title: Ruby Tart Cherry, Cranberry, Fennel & Culinary Lavender Cooler
recipes.summary: Brisk ruby cooler pairing culinary lavender and fennel seed infusion with pure tart cherry juice, unsweetened cranberry juice, sweet orange juice, and crisp apple juice over ice.

ingredient_details.note: steeped with fennel seed 4 minutes, strained and chilled
steeped alongside lavender and strained out

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender and lightly crushed fennel seeds in 1/2 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, remove infuser cleanly, and chill.
Fill a tall glass with ice cubes.
Pour in chilled lavender-fennel infusion, tart cherry juice, unsweetened cranberry juice, orange juice, and apple juice.
Stir well and enjoy cold.
tips: Sweet orange and apple balance brisk cranberry and tart cherry with zero added sugar.
Steeping fennel and lavender together inside a closed tea ball keeps the glass crystal-clear.

recipes.title: Chilled Cantaloupe, Orange, Sweet Basil & Culinary Lavender Fresca
recipes.summary: Silky coral-gold agua fresca blending chilled culinary lavender infusion with juicy cantaloupe chunks, fresh orange juice, sweet basil leaves, ginger, and crisp lime.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 3/4 cup hot water 4 minutes, strained and chilled

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 3/4 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain cleanly, and chill.
Blend chilled lavender infusion, cantaloupe chunks, orange juice, sweet basil leaves, grated ginger, and lime juice 25 seconds until light and frothy.
Strain smoothly over ice cubes in two glasses and serve right away.
tips: Pre-cut cantaloupe chunks make this glowing afternoon refresher effortless.
Sweet basil and culinary lavender belong to the same mint family and pair effortlessly with ripe melon.

recipes.title: Golden Apricot, Chamomile, Saffron & Culinary Lavender Nectar
recipes.summary: Luminous golden chilled nectar uniting culinary lavender, German chamomile, and saffron infusion with pure apricot nectar, sweet orange juice, and fresh ginger juice.

ingredient_details.note: steeped with chamomile and saffron, strained cleanly and chilled
1 tea bag steeped with lavender and saffron

steps: Steep 1 chamomile tea bag, 1/8 tsp culinary lavender, and a pinch of saffron threads in 1/2 cup boiling water covered 4 minutes; strain cleanly and chill.
Fill a tall glass with ice cubes.
Pour in the golden floral tea, pure apricot nectar, fresh orange juice, and ginger juice; stir gently and serve.
tips: Keep culinary lavender at a gentle 1/8 tsp here so chamomile, apricot, and saffron shine together in harmony.
Makes a graceful alcohol-free evening apéritif.

recipes.title: Rosy Raspberry, Crisp Apple, Clove & Culinary Lavender Spritz
recipes.summary: Sparkling blush-pink cooler pressing fresh raspberries into chilled clove-and-lavender infusion with pure apple juice, sweet orange juice, clapped spearmint, and sparkling water.

ingredient_details.note: steeped with whole clove 4 minutes, strained and chilled
steeped alongside lavender and removed cleanly

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender and 1 whole clove in 1/2 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, strain thoroughly, and chill.
Press thawed raspberries through a fine-mesh strainer directly into a tall glass using the back of a spoon.
Add ice cubes, clapped spearmint leaves, chilled spiced lavender infusion, pure apple juice, and orange juice.
Top with chilled sparkling water and stir lightly.
tips: Using thawed frozen raspberries lets you press vivid seedless juice straight into your glass in 15 seconds.
One single whole clove adds lovely warmth without overpowering delicate lavender.

recipes.title: Crimson Beetroot, Sweet Carrot, Ginger & Culinary Lavender Press
recipes.summary: Earthy jewel-red root press pairing pure beetroot and sweet carrot juices with chilled culinary lavender infusion, crisp apple juice, orange juice, and fresh ginger.

ingredient_details.note: steeped in 1/2 cup hot water 4 minutes, strained and chilled

steps: Steep 1/4 tsp culinary lavender in 1/2 cup hot water covered 4 minutes, lift out infuser cleanly, and chill.
Fill a tall glass with ice cubes.
Pour in chilled lavender infusion, cold-pressed beetroot juice, carrot juice, apple juice, orange juice, and ginger juice.
Stir thoroughly until glowing crimson-amber and enjoy cold.
tips: Bottled 100% cold-pressed beet and carrot juices keep your hands clean and make root tonics a 2-minute pour.
Ginger and bright orange balance deep root-vegetable earthiness smoothly.

recipes.title: Iced Black Tea, Sweet Orange, Anise & Culinary Lavender Cooler
recipes.summary: Crisp café iced tea cooler steeping black tea with culinary lavender and crushed anise seed, finished over ice with fresh sweet orange juice, apple juice, and fresh lemon balm.

ingredient_details.note: steeped with black tea and anise seed, strained cleanly and chilled
1 tea bag steeped with lavender and anise
steeped in tea infuser and removed

steps: Steep 1 black tea bag, 1/4 tsp culinary lavender, and crushed anise seeds in 3/4 cup hot water covered 4 minutes; strain thoroughly and chill.
Fill a tall glass with ice cubes and drop in lightly clapped lemon balm leaves.
Pour in chilled lavender-anise black tea, fresh orange juice, and pure apple juice; stir and serve cold.
tips: Use decaf black tea if you enjoy this citrus cooler late in the afternoon.
Brewing a 4-cup pitcher at once gives effortless iced café refreshers for several days.
